<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
We found a newt we've never seen,
so we came to report!

This is...
it seems an ordinary newt, but...

Whoa!
It stole my magnifying glass!
Ah, my glasses too...!

It seems this newt
has a habit of collecting shiny things.

One might call it the Snatcher Newt.
This is a new discovery!
